reviews.classification: complete selected weather/environment plan or coverage owner with bounded later evidence
reviews.disposition:
The complete selected-detail map and W6 field/forecast proposals were read alongside all51 lines of this combined coverage record; W6's final integration checkpoint245–end was checked as scoped followthrough. The initial pending-W3 plans and “dispatched, not verified” map are historical planning states. This owner and the [W6 checkpoint](../../W6.md) record a later bounded S1 candidate, concrete material/charge/grounding/kit/order use, six literal persistence checkpoints, four desktop/font cases and separate native vital-debit corrections. These are saved report claims at their pinned inputs; no underlying JSON, source, browser or3460-test run was newly verified by this documentation review. Earlier source-only states do not erase later evidence, and later bounded evidence does not prove current shared-tree parity or installed adoption.

Retain all PC44–PC53, F1–F5, G6E1–G6E7, G6A1–G6A5, J1 and SF1–SF8 scopes. The ORIGINAL apparatus's public committed schedule supports its observation/meter/calibration horizons2/6/12; it is not franchise outdoor meteorology. A sample retains observer/source/method/place/time/horizon, while preview remains inert and deliberate recording does not redraw truth. Stale reports retain historical meaning. Forecast uncertainty follows actual means, not a universal ban on a faculty that can truly know future events. Charge, moisture, cold and contamination have distinct carriers and remedies; a paid chamber/grounding prototype does not impose a cost on every world power. Sealing blocks this path and also blocks ventilation, rather than magically accelerating every drying process.

The remaining water/soil stages, light/pressure readers, flower/ripen/molt/migration source windows, regional property consumers, charged rain/ash, external planar tides and lunar/anomalous seasons stay separately open. A pilot cannot close them by renaming an apparatus. Preserve actual count/custody, split histories, passive exposure versus labor pause, local eligible clocks and retained fractions. The plan's apparent W3-event/W6-event ownership overlap is resolved by the later recorded seam: W6 supplies this ORIGINAL event law/forecast, W3 owns retained material/exposure integration; no second lot, clock, save or weather generator is selected. Historical queue/lock/release statements are not today's runtime custody. AD36/AD43 apply to current claims and human review stays optional. This reconciliation starts no weather implementation, source search, runtime check or private-save operation.
